descriere_scurta: Technology controller motorized potentiometer setpoint memory
descriere: Displays the setpoint memory for the motorized potentiometer of the technology controller. For p2230.0 = 1, the last setpoint that was saved is entered after ON.

descriere_scurta: Technology controller actual value after filter
descriere: Display and connector output for the smoothed actual value after the filter (PT1) of the technology controller.
Displays the error (system deviation) between the setpoint and actual value of the technology controller.

Displays the actual active operating mode. Value = 00 hex -> no operating mode active Value = 01 hex -> jogging active Value = 02 hex -> search for reference active Value = 04 hex -> traversing blocks active Value = 08 hex -> Positioning for direct setpoint input/MDI active Value = 10 hex -> Setting-up for direct setpoint input/MDI active Value = 20 hex -> flying referencing active
Displays the velocity setpoint presently being processed.
Displays the actual effective velocity override.
Displays the corrective value for the position actual value.

Connector output of the reference quantity for currents p2002. All currents specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. The reference quantity corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex (word) or 4000 0000 hex (double word). This parameter has the unit Arms.

Connector output of the reference quantity for accelerations p2007. All acceleration rates specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. The reference quantity corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex (word) or 4000 0000 hex (double word). The unit of this parameter is the same as the unit selected for p2007.
Displays the fault value of the oldest active fault.
Displays the OFF angle requested by the DC-link voltage controller (Vdc controller) in Smart Mode.
Displays the sum of the precontrol powers.

descriere_scurta: Infeed reactive current controller integral component
descriere: Displays the integral action component of the reactive current controller.

descriere_scurta: VSM input line supply voltage u2 - u3
descriere: Displays the input voltage between phases L2 and L3 for the Voltage Sensing Module (VSM).
Displays the number of parameters for this drive unit. The number comprises the device-specific and the drive-specific parameters.
Displays the status of digital inputs 16 ... 23 of Terminal Module 15 (TM15).
Displays the installation location of the sensor to evaluate the spindle supplementary temperature.

Displays the unfiltered speed setpoint N_SETPT in revolutions per minute for diagnostic purposes. In contrast to p1155, this value is updated in each DRIVE-CLiQ basic clock cycle and displayed with sign.
Display of the effective filter bandwidth for Sensor Module SMx10 (resolver) and SMx20 (sin/cos). The bandwidth of the filter is set using p4660.
Displays the Sensor Module Integrated 24 (SMI24) properties.
Displays the production date of the spindle.
Display and connector output for the estimated dynamic response of the speed control loop as PT1 time constant for onlinetuning.
Displays the total leakage inductance of the supply transformer determined using the identification (p5480 = 13). The result of the identification must be entered into p5490.

descriere_scurta: Par_circuit DC link voltage maximum deviation
descriere: Displays the maximum absolute deviation of the measured DC link voltage from the average value. The deviation of the individual voltages from the average value is displayed in r7030.
Status display for COMM BOARD.
Displays the DAP ID for PROFINET via the Communication Board Ethernet 20/25 (CBE20/CBE25). The combination of device ID (r8909) and DAP ID (r8959) uniquely identifies a PROFINET access point.

descriere_scurta: Number of BICO interconnections to other drives
descriere: Displays the number of signal sources from this drive to other drives/drive objects (Binector Output/Connector Output, BO/CO).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion crosswise comparison clock cycle
descriere: Displays the crosswise comparison clock cycle. The value indicates the clock cycle time with which each individual CDC value is compared between the two monitoring channels.
Displays the clock cycle time for the Safety Integrated Basic Functions on the Control Unit.

descriere_scurta: SI actual checksum SI parameters (Control Unit)
descriere: Displays the checksum over the checked Safety Integrated parameters on the Control Unit (actual checksum).
Displays the control word for the Basic Operator Panel (BOP).

Display and connector output for the temperature in the power unit. Index: [0] = Inverter maximum value [1] = Depletion layer maximum value [2] = Rectifier maximum value [3] = Air intake [4] = Interior of power unit [5] = Inverter 1 [6] = Inverter 2 [7] = Inverter 3 [8] = Inverter 4 [9] = Inverter 5 [10] = Inverter 6 [11] = Rectifier 1 [12] = Rectifier 2 [13] = Depletion layer 1 [14] = Depletion layer 2 [15] = Depletion layer 3 [16] = Depletion layer 4 [17] = Depletion layer 5 [18] = Depletion layer 6 [19] = Cooling unit liquid intake
Displays the energy values at the output terminals of the power unit. Index: [0] = Energy balance (sum) [1] = Energy drawn [2] = Energy fed back

descriere_scurta: Motor data set/encoder data set effective
descriere: Displays the effective Motor Data Set (MDS) and the effective Encoder Data Sets (EDS). Index: [0] = Motor Data Set MDS effective [1] = Encoder 1 Encoder Data Set EDS effective [2] = Encoder 2 Encoder Data Set EDS effective [3] = Encoder 3 Encoder Data Set EDS effective
Displays the effective Command Data Set (CDS).
Displays the effective Drive Data Set (DDS).

Display and connector output for the line frequency. Re index 0: Displays the instantaneous value of the line supply PLL. Re index 1: Displays the values smoothed with a time constant of 50 ms to monitor the frequency. Index: [0] = Unsmoothed [1] = Smoothed
Displays the actual phase voltage. Index: [0] = Phase U [1] = Phase V [2] = Phase W

Displays the automatically detected actual device topology in coded form. Index: [0] = DRIVE-CLiQ socket X100 [1] = DRIVE-CLiQ socket X101 [2] = DRIVE-CLiQ socket X102 [3] = DRIVE-CLiQ socket X103 [4] = DRIVE-CLiQ socket X104 [5] = DRIVE-CLiQ socket X105
The parameter contains the object number via which every drive object can be addressed. The number of an existing drive object is entered into each index. Value = 0: No drive object is defined.
Displays the number of existing or existing and prepared drive objects. Index: [0] = Existing drive objects [1] = Existing and prepared drive objects
Displays the recommended sampling time for the drive objects.
Displays the "active/inactive" state of a power unit component.
Displays the version of the EEPROM data of the power unit.
Displays the firmware version of the power unit.
Displays the "active" or "inactive" state of a Voltage Sensing Module (VSM).
Displays the firmware version of the Voltage Sensing Module (VSM).
Displays the properties supported by the Voltage Sensing Module (VSM).
Displays the status of the components. r0196[0]: group status of all components r0196[1]: Status of component with component number 1 ... r0196[255]: Status of component with component number 255
Displays the bootloader version. Index 0: Displays the bootloader version. Index 1: Displays the bootloader version 3 (for CU320-2 and CU310-2) Value 0 means that boot loader 3 is not available.

Freely assignable name for a drive object. In the commissioning software, this name cannot be entered using the expert list, but is specified in the configuration assistant. The object name can be subsequently modified in the Project Navigator using standard Windows resources.
Displays the type of power unit found.
Displays the properties supported by the power unit hardware.

Displays the rated power unit power for various load duty cycles. Index: [0] = Rated value [1] = Load duty cycle with low overload [2] = Load duty cycle with high overload [3] = S1 cont duty cyc [4] = S6 load duty cycle

Displays the maximum output current of the power unit. Index: [0] = Catalog [1] = Load duty cycle with low overload [2] = Load duty cycle with high overload [3] = S1 load duty cycle [4] = S6 load duty cycle
Display and BICO output for the status of the inputs/outputs of the power unit contactors. The display is activated in p0212.5.
Displays the control word for the cooling unit.
Displays the status word of the cooling unit.

Sets the shutdown thresholds for the ground fault monitoring. The setting is made as a percentage of the maximum current of the power unit (r0209). Index: [0] = Threshold at which pre-charging starts [1] = Threshold at which pre-charging stops

descriere_scurta: Motor code number of motor with DRIVE-CLiQ
descriere: Displays the motor code number from the saved motor data from a motor with DRIVE-CLiQ.
Displays the rated motor slip.
Displays the torque constant of the synchronous motor used.
Displays the rated frequency of the motor. For p0310 > 0, this value is displayed.
Displays the rated EMF of the motor.
Displays the rated motor voltage.
Displays the identified rated motor current.
Displays the rated motor starting time. This time corresponds to the time from standstill up to reaching the motor rated speed and the acceleration with motor rated torque (r0333).
Displays the motor stator resistance at an ambient temperature (p0625). The value does not include the cable resistance.
Displays the total cable resistance between Motor Module and motor, as well as the internal converter resistance.
Displays the rated motor stator resistance at rated temperature (total of p0625 and p0627).

descriere_scurta: Motor rotor resistance cold / damping resistance d axis
descriere: Displays the rotor/secondary section resistance of the motor for the ambient temperature p0625. For separately-excited synchronous motors: Displays the damping resistance in the rotor direction (d-axis).
Displays the nominal rotor / secondary section resistance of the motor at the rated temperature. The rated temperature is the sum of p0625 and p0628.

Displays the total stray inductance of the motor. Induction motor: Displays the stator leakage inductance of the motor including the series inductance (p0353). Synchronous motor: Displays the stator quadrature axis inductance of the motor including the series inductance (p0353).
Displays the stator longitudinal inductance of the synchronous motor including the series inductance (p0353) and the motor reactor (p0233).
Displays the damping inductance of the separately-excited synchronous motor in the rotor direction (d-axis).
Displays the damping inductance of a separately-excited synchronous motor quadrature to the rotor direction (q axis).

descriere_scurta: Motor magnetizing inductance q axis saturated
descriere: Displays the saturated magnetizing inductance of a separately-excited synchronous motor quadrature to the rotor direction (q axis).

descriere_scurta: Motor rotor time constant / damping time constant d axis
descriere: Displays the rotor time constant. For separately-excited synchronous motors: Displays the damping time constant to the rotor direction (d axis).

descriere_scurta: Motor damping time constant q axis
descriere: Displays the damping time constant of a separately-excited synchronous motor quadrature to the rotor direction (q axis).
Displays the stator leakage time constant.

descriere_scurta: Motor stator leakage time constant q axis
descriere: Displays the stator leakage time constant quadrature to the rotor direction (q axis).
Displays the actual stator resistance (phase value). The parameter value also contains the temperature-independent cable resistance.
Displays the actual rotor/secondary section resistance (phase value). The parameter is affected by the motor temperature model.
Displays the relationship between the electrical and mechanical pole positions. Index: [0] = Encoder 1 [1] = Encoder 2 [2] = Encoder 3

Displays the identification/serial number of encoder 1. Index 0 = first character of the identification number ... Index x = 20 hex (blank) --> separation between the identification number of serial number Index x + 1 = 2F hex (slash) --> separation between the identification number of serial number Index x + 2 = 20 hex (blank) --> separation between the identification number of serial number Index x + 3 = first character of the serial number ... Index y with contents = last character of the serial number

Displays the identification/serial number of encoder 2. Index 0 = first character of the identification number ... Index x = 20 hex (blank) --> separation between the identification number of serial number Index x + 1 = 2F hex (slash) --> separation between the identification number of serial number Index x + 2 = 20 hex (blank) --> separation between the identification number of serial number Index x + 3 = first character of the serial number ... Index y with contents = last character of the serial number

Displays the identification/serial number of encoder 3. Index 0 = first character of the identification number ... Index x = 20 hex (blank) --> separation between the identification number of serial number Index x + 1 = 2F hex (slash) --> separation between the identification number of serial number Index x + 2 = 20 hex (blank) --> separation between the identification number of serial number Index x + 3 = first character of the serial number ... Index y with contents = last character of the serial number

descriere_scurta: Assignment parameter 10 in reference to p514[9]
descriere: Assignment parameter for user-specific scaling. By indexing the assignment parameter p524[0..19], a total of 20 BiCos are available, which should be scaled corresponding to the user-specific scaling. The significance of the assignment parameters is as follows: p524[0] BiCo number assigned p514[9] (reference quantity 10) .. p524[19] BiCo number assigned p514[9] (reference quantity 10)

Display and connector output for the time stamp MT_ZS_1 up to MT_ZS_16. Displays the measuring time for an edge at the digital input for the "central measuring probe evaluation stage 3" function. The measuring time is specified as 16-bit value with a resolution of 0.25 µs. Priority: MT1 ... MT8, oldest ... newest time stamp
Display and connector output for the time stamp reference MT_ZSB1 up to MT_ZSB4.
Displays the ambient temperature of the motor temperature model (models 2 and 3).
Displays the stator iron temperature of the motor temperature model (models 2 and 3).
Displays the stator winding temperature of the motor temperature model (models 2 and 3).
Displays the rotor temperature of the motor temperature model (model 2).

descriere_scurta: Central measuring probe measuring time rising edge
descriere: Displays the measuring time for a rising edge at the digital input for the "central measuring probe evaluation" function. The measuring time is specified as 16-bit value with a resolution of 0.25 µs. r0686[0]: Measuring time, rising edge measuring probe 1 r0686[1]: Measuring time, rising edge measuring probe 2 r0686[2]: Measuring time, rising edge measuring probe 3 r0686[3]: Measuring time, rising edge measuring probe 4 r0686[4]: Measuring time, rising edge measuring probe 5 r0686[5]: Measuring time, rising edge measuring probe 6 r0686[6]: Measuring time, rising edge measuring probe 7 r0686[7]: Measuring time, rising edge measuring probe 8

descriere_scurta: Central measuring probe measuring time falling edge
descriere: Displays the measuring time for a falling edge at the digital input for the "central measuring probe evaluation" function. The measuring time is specified as 16-bit value with a resolution of 0.25 µs. r0687[0]: Measuring time, falling edge measuring probe 1 r0687[1]: Measuring time, falling edge measuring probe 2 r0687[2]: Measuring time, falling edge measuring probe 3 r0687[3]: Measuring time, falling edge measuring probe 4 r0687[4]: Measuring time, falling edge measuring probe 5 r0687[5]: Measuring time, falling edge measuring probe 6 r0687[6]: Measuring time, falling edge measuring probe 7 r0687[7]: Measuring time, falling edge measuring probe 8
Sets the setpoint for the cam outputs. Index: [0] = Bit 0 [1] = Bit 1 [2] = Bit 2 [3] = Bit 3 [4] = Bit 4 [5] = Bit 5 [6] = Bit 6 [7] = Bit 7
Display and BICO output for the cam outputs.

descriere_scurta: CU analog input smoothing time constant
descriere: Sets the smoothing time constant of the 1st-order low pass filter for the analog input. Index: [0] = AI0 (X131.7, 8)

descriere_scurta: CU analog input characteristic value y2
descriere: Sets the scaling characteristic for the analog input of the CU310-2. The scaling characteristic for the analog input is defined using 2 points. This parameter specifies the y coordinate (percentage) of the 2nd value pair of the characteristic. Index: [0] = AI0 (X131.7, 8)
